citations.claim: first violation: controller force 486.875 exceeds fmax 72.67 at step 29 after collision
controller force exceeds limit at step 29
step 28 just before collision force is within limit ~6.5 N and bodies are touching

counterfactual.change: Reduced kp from 26.765 to 3.0 (single field) to test that uncapped proportional gain caused the exceedance; same 29 steps, same geometry, now passes controller_force_limit

explanation: Controller force is computed as kp * velocity-error without clamping to fmax. Steps 27-28 show normal force ~6-7 N (within 72.67 limit) while bodies approach. At step 28 bodies 0 and 1 are touching (gap 0.005). Collision impulse at step 29 spikes body 0 speed from ~2.9 to 10.27 m/s and reverses velocity, creating large velocity error against the waypoint-directed vcmd. With kp=26.76 the proportional force jumps to 486.9 N, far exceeding fmax=72.67. Lowering kp to 3.0 removes the violation, confirming uncapped proportional gain is the cause.
vision_note: In tiles 26-28 the large blue controller-driven body moves toward the green waypoint and contacts the small red body positioned just above it. In tile 29 the bodies abruptly separate with the blue body deflected down-right away from the waypoint, showing a sudden collision-induced reversal of motion.
